name: Iran
description: Follow Iran, a tracked place, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Product availability changed in Europe
changes.summary: Ahead of a flight from Turkey, President Trump secretly left Air Force One and was moved to another plane with the help of a catering truck, according to a source, as the U.S. grappled with a threat from Iran.

changes.title: Morning news brief
changes.summary: Voters in six states head to the polls Tuesday for high-profile primaries, Trump signals his strategy with Iran is shifting, 7.4 magnitude earthquake kills at least 111 people in Colombia.

changes.title: NATO spending pressure returned
changes.summary: President Donald Trump secretly flew out of last month's NATO summit in Ankara, Turkey, on an alternate military aircraft while the White House made it appear that the Republican president was flying on Air Force One, according to a report published by The Washington Post on Monday.

changes.title: Secret Service operation to swap Trump’s planes amid Iran threat
changes.summary: We are learning new details about the elaborate Secret Service operation to swap President Trump’s planes amid an Iranian assassination threat. NBC News’ Garrett Haake reports.

changes.title: U.S. stocks edge further from their records as oil prices keep swinging
changes.summary: U.S. stocks slipped a bit further from their records Tuesday, while oil prices kept swinging on uncertainty about when the war with Iran will allow crude to flow freely again.

changes.title: Top adviser to Iran's Revolutionary Guard leader sits down for rare interview
changes.summary: As the war with Iran continues its uneasy stalemate, we're hearing from a top adviser to the commander of Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps, the force largely responsible for border and internal security. changes.title: The U.S. Missile Stockpile Is Dangerously Low
changes.summary: The United States’ war with Iran has caused a critical weaponry shortage. That leaves the U.S. military vulnerable and complicates Washington’s efforts to end the war.

changes.title: How Iran Adapted Its Attacks as U.S. War Munitions Dwindled
changes.summary: The Iranian strikes that killed three U.S. soldiers in Jordan show how quickly Iran’s war-fighting skills have evolved, as the Pentagon runs low on interceptors.

changes.summary: President Trump hid in an airport catering container and was taken to a military jet for a secret flight out of country after the NATO summit last month.
